qrscan.name: QR Code Scanner
qrscan.description: Reads QR codes from an image you browse for, paste, drag in or link to.
qrscan.title: QR Code Scanner

drop.label: Choose an image of a QR code
drop.title: Drop, paste or browse for an image of a QR code
drop.hint: Images stay in your browser and are never uploaded.

url.label: Image URL, SVG or base64 image
url.placeholder: Or paste an image URL, SVG or base64

status.noCode: No QR code found in this image. Try a sharper or closer picture.
status.tooLarge: That image is too large. The limit is 25 MB.
status.badUrl: That isn’t an image URL, SVG or base64 image. Links must start with http:// or https://.
status.urlsOff: Scanning image links is turned off on this instance. Download the image and drop it here instead.
status.expired: This scanner has been open too long. Search again to scan image links.

bareQr.label: Show for a plain “qr”
bareQr.description: Show the scanner when the whole search is just “qr” or “qr code”. Searches such as “qr code reader” or “scan qr” always show it.

imageUrls.label: Scan image links
imageUrls.description: Load images from links through degoog’s image proxy, which refuses private addresses and anything that isn’t an image. Turn this off on a public instance to keep visitors from using the proxy for arbitrary images. Files, pasted images, SVG and base64 still work.
